name: Apprenticeship — Draft POST, Approved, Different Provider Posts
description: SLD POSTs a draft apprenticeship for Provider A (standard 21), Commitments approves it via ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent, then Provider B POSTs the same learner onto the same course (standard 21). Apprenticeships have no dedicated Change of Provider feature (unlike short courses), so this captures baseline behaviour: CreateDraftApprenticeshipLearningCommandHandler.Handle looks up the existing draft via GetAllByLearnerKey(learner.Key, ukprn, courseCode), scoped by UKPRN as well as course code — Provider B's UKPRN doesn't match Provider A's approved episode, so the lookup finds no match and a second, independent unapproved ApprenticeshipLearning row is created for Provider B rather than the POST being treated as an update to Provider A's approved row.

steps.name: SLD (Provider A) Creates a Draft Apprenticeship
Commitments Approves the Draft Apprenticeship (Provider A)
SLD (Provider B) Creates a Draft Apprenticeship for the Same Learner and Course

assertions.name: Two separate ApprenticeshipLearning rows exist for the learner, one per provider
Provider A's episode remains approved, Provider B's is an unapproved draft
